Backend pytest 19/19 pass (100%) covering feeds, IP allow/block, per-link protection incl. datacenter->fallback 302, blocker API v1/v2 (auth, block=true for DC, request_count increments), admin overview + security-events + users + workspaces + api-usage + global-blocklist, and non-admin 403. Frontend: nav-admin correctly HIDDEN for a fresh non-admin registration and VISIBLE for admin@midgate.io. ProtectionPage /app/protection shows feeds-card (Tor + datacenter counts), tabs tab-rules/tab-ip/tab-sim work; IP-rule add+delete via UI verified; Simulator returned decision='block' for AWS 3.5.1.1 + curl/8.0. New Security Rule dialog with is_tor + boolean true/false value select saved OK. Link detail Protection card has all 10 required data-testids (prot-enabled, prot-block_bots/tor/datacenter/proxy_vpn, prot-action, prot-redirect-url, prot-block-countries, prot-rate-limit, prot-save-btn) and saved successfully ('Protection settings saved'). issues: Legacy '9.9.9.0/24' entry shown with a 'bad range' note from a prior admin verification — harmless but shows old data.

critical_code_review_comments: security.evaluate_request correctly orders whitelist -> blocklist -> per-link protection -> rules -> risk. Global blocklist merged with workspace blocklist. Good.
IP validation in security._validate_ip_value handles both bare IPs and CIDR via ipaddress module; 400 on bad values. Admin global-blocklist reuses same check. Good.
blocker._blocker treats decision in ('block','challenge') as block=true — matches spec (no interstitial on pure API). resolve_key uses SHA256 of raw key; raw returned only on POST. Good.
apikeys._public correctly excludes key_hash from list responses. Good.
admin.require_admin gates every /api/admin/* route via user.role=='admin' — verified 403 for a normal user across 6 endpoints.
redirect._apply_block: 'fallback' with no URL falls through to 403 block_page — expected. 'redirect' requires a URL, else falls through to 403 (safe default).
TTL caches (_RULES_CACHE, _IP_CACHE, _GLOBAL_CACHE) are 15s per workspace — appropriate. Invalidated on mutation. Tests sleep 16s to bypass — acceptable.
links.create_link seeds link['protection'] = {**DEFAULT_PROTECTION}. GET/PATCH /links/{id}/protection correctly merge over DEFAULT_PROTECTION for backwards compat with older docs.

Minor: security.evaluate_request accepts allow_countries in per-link protection; when non-empty AND signals.country is 'Unknown' (no CF-IPCountry header), request will be BLOCKED as 'not allowlisted'. Since geo is currently always 'Unknown', enabling allow_countries in production could break traffic. Consider gating on 'country != Unknown' or documenting this caveat.

Minor: DEFAULT_PROTECTION includes 'allow_countries' but ProtectionInput schema on the PATCH endpoint does allow it. UI does not expose an input for allow_countries — only block_countries — which is fine since geo detection is stubbed.
Minor: blocker RATE_PER_MIN=1200 is a per-process in-memory counter (intel.rate_limiter). In a multi-worker deploy this is soft — consider Redis-backed limiter for production.
No secrets leak from admin responses: /admin/api-usage projects out key_hash. Good.
